title: Page 362
transc:
Ft Monroe Feb 11 - 1865
S. H.Beckwith City Point Va.
Snake oyster torch abner Federal Vernon abacus February
paddle peasant animal Lucy fence for John black
zebra Shelter zodiac I arrived here this morning
with plug quincy zodiac Have had very rough
weather and been much delayed by it zodiac
I hope to get the whisky all landed
by whelp night and send the whimpers back
forth other quitmans unity There is no apparent
change sligo situation since you were here I
propose to commence opera shuns at once without
waiting forth other whinny as time is important 
unity I think I can take Saco Anderson
and possibly hamlet withy salem I now have
youth Very respectfully Kiss Geo. D. Sheldon


Ft Monroe Feb 14 - 1865
S. H. Beckwith City Point - Maj. Eckert , Wash'n.
Farmer female for Jersey blubber zodiac I have the honor
to wick that I left Hill turn head on the
fence instant on the weasel ship Arago and arrived in
Hemp town wileys last night having experienced a torrent ripley
early gale off Hatteras unity Maxim relieved me torch polka
torch quadrant torch waxy on the pony instant zodiac The
Military news that I bring is not important ditto a
white had reached Hill town head as I was leaving
that Knapsack had taken Branchville but I could not trace
